# Email draft · Dr. Noura — intent parser meeting

To: (Dr. Noura's email — not stored in vault, to be filled in)
Subject: CS 499 — meeting request: intent parser design for Saut

---

Dear Dr. Noura,

I hope you are doing well.

I would like to book a short meeting with you to discuss the intent parser for Saut,
our graduation project. Speech-to-text is now working with Whisper, and we have 50 Gulf
Arabic test commands recorded, so the intent parser is the remaining blocker before the
prototype demo on 15 November.

Specifically, I would value your guidance on:

1. The approach — rule-based/keyword matching vs. a trained intent classifier, given our
   small dataset.
2. Handling Gulf Arabic phrasing and filler words in the transcripts.
3. What you would expect to see demonstrated for the parser at the 15 November demo.

Would you be available for 20–30 minutes at either of these times?

- Sunday 1 November, 10:00–11:00
- Monday 2 November, after class / your office hours

If neither suits you, I am happy to work around your schedule.

Thank you very much for your time.

Best regards,
Sami
Computer Science, Level 8 — CS 499 (supervised by Dr. Noura)

---

### Notes for Sami
- Send manually: no email-sending tool is wired up in this vault.
- Once she replies, tick off the pending item in MEMORY.MD and log the meeting date here.
